name: Lastlight Underkeep - Reference-led dungeon
subtitle: Supplied lighthouse dungeon reference vs Blender-authored Underkeep
review_note: The Underkeep carries the defining grey cavern, tidal water, moss, perimeter elevation, stalagmites, stalactites and a visible return ladder without copying the source layout.
verdict: accepted as the first traversable Underkeep foundation
improve: Expand the dungeon's quest and enemy purpose only after live traversal and visibility are proven.
